title: Hopemore Mine locality surface ruins (2024)
label: Modern photograph — surface ruins and mine waste at named Hopemore Mine locality; structures not individually identified
sourceNote: Original photograph by Clyde Charles Brown on 10 October 2024, from Wikimedia Commons. Visually inspected 1280px image showing collapsed timber surface workings, a small standing building, and mine waste. 1280px resized JPEG selected for efficient app and offline copies. Exact structures and shaft collar not independently identified; do not portray this as a historical photograph or an entrance.
identityEvidence: Original photographer's own Commons description explicitly names Hopemore Mine, Colorado, US. EXIF camera GPS 39.245748,-106.234613 is approximately 115 m from the USGS-derived V4 named Hopemore Mine locality 39.2447121,-106.2347446. Visually inspected the actual photo of mining surface ruins and waste. The V4 anchor is only an approximate named locality, so this image is of that locality, not independently verified exact shaft or specific building. Avoid conflating nearby Ibex workings.
